You can create, validate, and approve contracts with unlimited approval steps, organize workflows by teams, and receive automated email notifications. With full support for multi-company and multi-currency environments, this solution makes contract management faster, more accurate, and easier for your team.

name: Inter Warehouse Transfer
description: Inter Warehouse Transfer for Odoo enables businesses to efficiently manage stock movement between multiple warehouses by generating internal transfer orders with automated inventory adjustments and complete traceability. The module supports approval workflows, stock availability checks, and detailed transfer logs, ensuring accurate and controlled operations across single or multi-company environments. With seamless integration into Odoo’s Inventory, Sales, Purchase, and Manufacturing modules, it helps businesses maintain better visibility, optimize logistics, and ensure smooth warehouse operations.

name: Purchase and Vendor Bills Discount
description: This Odoo app enables users to apply discounts on Purchase Orders and Vendor Bills using two flexible methods: Fixed Discount and Percentage Discount. Once installed, the selected discount type and amount are automatically displayed on the default Odoo reports for Purchase Orders and Supplier Invoices. However, it's important to note that this module does not generate accounting entries for the discount amount.
